summary_en: This trial tests sEphB4-HSA, an EphrinB2 inhibitor, combined with immunotherapy and other treatment regimens in patients with EphrinB2-high solid tumors. The listed conditions are muscle-invasive bladder carcinoma and metastatic urothelial carcinoma. sEphB4-HSA is given by intravenous infusion over 60 minutes on days 1 and 8 of each cycle, and treatment continues until the prespecified number of cycles is completed, the disease progresses, or toxicity becomes unacceptable. The primary objective is to demonstrate additive therapeutic benefit from sEphB4-HSA, and the study is Phase 2/3.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa sEphB4-HSA, un inhibidor de EphrinB2, combinado con inmunoterapia y otros esquemas de tratamiento en pacientes con tumores sólidos de alta expresión de EphrinB2. Las condiciones listadas son carcinoma de vejiga músculo-invasivo y carcinoma urotelial metastásico. sEphB4-HSA se administra por infusión intravenosa durante 60 minutos los días 1 y 8 de cada ciclo, y el tratamiento continúa hasta completar el número de ciclos prespecificado, hasta que la enfermedad progrese o hasta que la toxicidad sea inaceptable. El objetivo principal es demostrar un beneficio terapéutico aditivo de sEphB4-HSA, y el estudio es de Fase 2/3.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older who are willing and able to give informed consent
Tumor must express EphrinB2, as assessed by the central lab
Zubrod performance status of 1 or less
Urothelial carcinoma, not pure small cell, with no systemic cancer therapy in the previous 12 months
Adequate organ function on labs obtained within 14 days before randomization
not_for: Symptomatic brain metastases requiring systemic corticosteroids, with some exceptions
Active or past autoimmune disorders, or conditions that impair the immune system
Known active bacterial, fungal or viral infection, including hepatitis B or C, or HIV
Any known active chronic liver disease
Active second cancer requiring systemic therapy, or severe reaction to a monoclonal antibody
